products.name: CardiAMP Cell Therapy System
products.description: An autologous mononuclear cell therapy platform for the treatment of ischemic heart failure with reduced ejection fraction (HFrEF) and chronic myocardial ischemia, involving a cell potency screening test, point-of-care cell processing, and a proprietary catheter-based biotherapeutic delivery system. The system is manufactured using physical devices and biological processing, and is delivered in a clinical setting by physicians.

products.name: CardiALLO Allogeneic MSC Therapy
products.description: An allogeneic, 'off the shelf' mesenchymal stem cell therapy platform for the treatment of ischemic heart failure with reduced ejection fraction (HFrEF), manufactured at the company's facility and delivered via clinical infusion. This product is produced through cell culture expansion and is intended for broad patient use without the need for patient-specific cell harvesting.

products.name: PulmALLO Allogeneic MSC Therapy
products.description: An allogeneic mesenchymal stem cell therapy for the treatment of acute respiratory distress syndrome (ARDS), produced via culture expansion and administered intravenously. The product is manufactured at the company's facility and is designed to modulate inflammation in critically ill patients.

products.name: Helix Biotherapeutic Delivery System
products.description: A proprietary transendocardial catheter-based delivery system for minimally invasive, targeted delivery of biologic agents to the heart. The system is physically manufactured and sold to partners and other biotherapeutic developers for use in clinical and commercial cardiac interventions.

products.name: Morph Steerable Introducer Catheters
products.description: A family of steerable vascular access catheters, including Morph and Morph-DNA, designed to facilitate access and control during cardiac and vascular procedures. These devices are physically manufactured and sold for use in various interventional procedures, including transseptal cardiac, renal, and peripheral artery interventions.

products.name: Memory Interface Chips
products.description: Complete chipset solutions for DDR5 and LPDDR5 memory modules, including components such as Registering Clock Drivers, Data Buffers, Power Management ICs, and sensors, manufactured using a fabless model and sold to memory module manufacturers, OEMs, and hyperscalers.

products.name: Silicon IP Solutions
products.description: Licensable high-performance interface and security IP, including memory controller IP, chip-to-chip digital controller IP, and security IP, integrated by chip makers into custom silicon, ASSPs, and FPGAs for AI, data center, government, and automotive applications.

products.name: Patent Licensing
products.description: Licensing of Rambus's broad portfolio of semiconductor, memory architecture, high-speed serial link, and security patents to semiconductor and system companies, generating royalty and licensing revenue.

products.name: Group-Oriented Destination Hotels and Resorts
products.description: Upscale, meetings-focused hotels and resorts operated under the Gaylord Hotels and JW Marriott brands, offering integrated lodging, extensive meeting and convention space, food and beverage, spa, golf, and entertainment amenities. Properties are physically owned and managed by Marriott, targeting large group meetings and regional leisure travelers.

products.name: Live Entertainment Venues and Events
products.description: Operation and management of iconic live music and entertainment venues, including the Grand Ole Opry, Ryman Auditorium, Austin City Limits Live at the Moody Theater, and amphitheaters, as well as production of live shows, concerts, and national music festivals. Delivered through in-person events at owned or managed venues and through event production companies.

products.name: Restaurant, Bar, and Music Venue Complexes
products.description: Ownership and operation of themed restaurant, bar, and live music venues such as Ole Red and Category 10, offering food, beverage, and live entertainment experiences in large, branded physical locations.

products.name: Radio Broadcasting
products.description: Operation of WSM-AM, a clear channel radio station broadcasting country music and live Grand Ole Opry performances, reaching a wide geographic audience via traditional radio and digital streaming.

products.name: Showboat Entertainment Cruises
products.description: Operation of the General Jackson Showboat, providing river cruises with Broadway-style shows and theatrical productions, serving tourists and convention guests in Nashville. Delivered via a physical showboat with onboard entertainment and dining.

products.name: Golf Course Operations
products.description: Ownership and operation of championship golf courses such as Gaylord Springs Golf Links and TPC San Antonio, offering golf experiences and event hosting as part of the resort amenities. Delivered through physical golf facilities adjacent to hotel properties.

products.name: Mixed-Use Entertainment Complexes
products.description: Ownership of mixed-use complexes like Block 21, which combine entertainment venues, lodging, office, and retail spaces, including the W Austin hotel and Austin City Limits Live. Delivered through integrated physical properties in urban locations.

products.name: Hypoimmune Pancreatic Islet Cell Therapy for Type 1 Diabetes
products.description: A cell therapy product (SC451) consisting of hypoimmune, stem cell-derived pancreatic islet cells engineered to evade immune rejection, manufactured at scale and delivered via transplantation to restore insulin production in type 1 diabetes patients without the need for immunosuppression.

products.name: In Vivo CAR T Cell Therapy for B Cell Malignancies and Autoimmune Diseases
products.description: A gene therapy product (SG293) using proprietary fusogen technology to deliver a CAR gene directly to CD8+ T cells in vivo, enabling the patient's own T cells to become CAR T cells targeting B cells, for the treatment of B cell cancers and B cell mediated autoimmune diseases, without the need for ex vivo cell manipulation or lymphodepleting chemotherapy.

products.name: Frequency Control Products
products.description: Manufactured quartz crystal resonators, oscillators (including VCXO, TCXO, OCXO, TCVCXO), and related devices for precise frequency and timing control in electronic circuits. Production involves advanced materials, MEMS, and compensation methods, delivered as physical components for integration into customer systems.

products.name: Spectrum Control Products
products.description: Manufactured RF, microwave, and millimeter wave filters, diplexers, and solid-state power amplifiers (10W to 10kW, 1 MHz to 30 GHz) using various technologies (crystal, ceramic, LC, cavity, etc.), delivered as physical components or subsystems for commercial and military aerospace, defense, space, avionics, and industrial markets.

products.name: Integrated Microwave Assemblies and RF Solutions
products.description: Custom-designed, integrated multi-functional modules and microwave assemblies (including filters, amplifiers, couplers, switches, oscillators, mixers, phase shifters, and control circuitry) spanning 10 MHz to 50 GHz, manufactured and assembled to meet stringent aerospace, defense, avionics, and industrial requirements, delivered as complete assemblies for system integration.

products.name: Gallium Nitride (GaN) Power Integrated Circuits (ICs)
products.description: Navitas designs and markets GaN-based power ICs that integrate drive, control, and protection circuits into a single chip, manufactured using a fabless model and delivered as packaged semiconductor devices for high-power applications such as AI data centers, grid infrastructure, and industrial electrification.

products.name: Silicon Carbide (SiC) Power Devices (MOSFETs and Diodes)
products.description: Navitas offers high-voltage SiC MOSFETs and diodes, leveraging proprietary trench-assisted planar technology, manufactured via third-party foundries and delivered as packaged semiconductor devices for high-power, high-voltage applications in data centers, grid infrastructure, and industrial systems.

products.name: High-Speed Silicon System Controllers and Digital Isolators
products.description: Navitas develops and sells high-speed silicon-based system controllers and digital isolators, which are used in power conversion and charging systems, typically as part of integrated solutions for high-power electronics.

products.name: Solid State Transformers (SSTs) for Grid Infrastructure
products.description: Navitas supplies solid state transformer solutions utilizing GaN and SiC devices, designed for modern grid and data center infrastructure, providing high-efficiency AC-DC conversion at high voltages, manufactured through integration of their semiconductor products with system-level engineering.

products.name: Fully Automatic Transmissions for On-Highway Vehicles
products.description: Manufacture and sale of fully automatic transmissions for medium- and heavy-duty commercial vehicles, including trucks, buses, motorhomes, and vocational vehicles. Products are highly engineered, require advanced manufacturing, and are delivered through OEMs and a global distributor network.

products.name: Electric and Hybrid Propulsion Solutions for Commercial Vehicles
products.description: Design, manufacture, and sale of electric hybrid and fully electric propulsion systems for commercial vehicles, primarily buses and select truck applications. These are digital and electromechanical systems produced in specialized facilities and delivered to OEMs.

products.name: Drivetrain and Motion Solutions for Off-Highway Equipment
products.description: Production and sale of drivetrain systems, propulsion components, axles, gearboxes, and motion technologies for mobile and stationary off-highway equipment in industries such as construction, agriculture, mining, material handling, and energy. These are complex mechanical systems manufactured in global facilities.

products.name: Propulsion Solutions for Defense Vehicles
products.description: Manufacture and sale of propulsion systems, including transmissions and hybrid/electric solutions, for medium- and heavy-tactical wheeled and tracked defense vehicles. Products are engineered for military specifications and delivered to OEMs and government agencies.

products.name: Service Parts and Transmission Fluids
products.description: Sale of Allison-branded service parts and transmission fluids for maintenance and repair of vehicles using Allison products. These are distributed through a global network of dealers and distributors.

products.name: Remanufactured Propulsion Solutions
products.description: Provision of remanufactured transmissions and propulsion systems (sold under the ReTran brand) as cost-effective alternatives for repairs and replacements. These are rebuilt products distributed through the aftermarket network.

products.name: Aluminum Die Cast Components
products.description: Manufacture and sale of aluminum die cast components used in propulsion systems and other industrial applications. These are produced in dedicated facilities and sold to OEMs and other customers.

products.name: Support Equipment for OEMs and Dealers
products.description: Sale of specialized support equipment to OEMs and dealers to assist in the installation and servicing of Allison propulsion solutions. These are physical tools and devices distributed through the company’s network.

products.name: Creative Visual Content Licensing
products.description: Licensing of royalty-free photos, illustrations, vectors, videos, and generative AI-generated images for commercial use, delivered digitally via e-commerce platforms and subscriptions. Content is sourced from a global contributor network and is available for immediate download.

products.name: Editorial Visual Content Licensing
products.description: Licensing of photos and videos covering news, sports, and entertainment events, including both contemporary coverage and access to a large historical archive. Content is produced by staff and freelance photographers and distributed digitally to media and corporate customers.

products.name: Custom Content Creation Services
products.description: Production of customized and exclusive project-specific visual content (photos, illustrations, videos) for clients, leveraging a global network of photographers and videographers. Delivered digitally, often as part of a subscription or assignment-based model.

products.name: Generative AI Visual Content Services
products.description: Commercially safe AI-powered image and video generation services, trained on Getty Images’ creative content, available via web platforms and APIs. Includes indemnification and contributor compensation for training data usage.

products.name: Music Licensing
products.description: Licensing of music tracks for commercial and editorial use, available as part of image and video content subscriptions or as standalone products. Delivered digitally through e-commerce platforms.

products.name: Digital Asset Management Solutions
products.description: Provision of cloud-based digital asset management tools (e.g., Media Manager) that enable customers to organize, store, and manage their licensed visual content. Delivered as a software service integrated with content licensing.

products.name: Content API and Integration Services
products.description: APIs and plugins that allow customers and partners to access, search, and integrate Getty Images’ content and metadata into their own workflows, platforms, and applications (e.g., Canva, Adobe Creative Cloud, WordPress).

products.name: Data and Metadata Licensing
products.description: Licensing of visual asset data and associated metadata for use in developing artificial intelligence, machine learning tools, and other data-driven applications. Delivered digitally to technology and research customers.

products.name: Print Sales
products.description: Sales of physical prints of licensed images from Getty Images’ archives and collections, delivered as tangible products to customers.

products.name: Optical Genome Mapping (OGM) Systems
products.description: Integrated systems (including Saphyr and Stratys instruments, chips, reagents, and labeling kits) for high-resolution detection and analysis of structural variants in genomes, delivered through physical manufacturing of instruments and consumables, and supported by proprietary software.

products.name: OGM Consumables and Reagents
products.description: Proprietary consumables (chips, flowcells) and reagents (sample prep and labeling kits) required for sample processing and genome mapping on OGM systems, manufactured using semiconductor fabrication and specialized chemistry.

products.name: Nucleic Acid Extraction and Purification Systems
products.description: Automated systems (notably the Ionic Purification system) for extracting and purifying DNA and RNA from various sample types using proprietary isotachophoresis (ITP) technology, including instruments, consumables, and reagents, physically manufactured and sold to genomics labs.

products.name: Genome Analysis Software Solutions
products.description: Platform-agnostic software (including VIA and Solve) for analysis, visualization, interpretation, and reporting of genomic data from OGM, NGS, and microarray platforms, delivered as web-based, cloud, or server-based digital products, monetized via pay-per-sample and licensing models.

products.name: OGM-Based Diagnostic and Laboratory Testing Services
products.description: Clinical and research laboratory services, including OGM-based laboratory developed tests (LDTs) for specific genetic disorders (e.g., FSHD1), and research-use-only (RUO) OGM testing, performed in CLIA-certified labs for external customers such as clinicians, researchers, and pharmaceutical companies.

products.name: Polθ Inhibitor Therapeutics (e.g., RP-3467)
products.description: Small molecule drugs that inhibit DNA polymerase theta (Polθ) ATPase activity, developed using synthetic chemistry and manufactured via contract manufacturing organizations. Delivered as targeted cancer therapies for tumors with homologous recombination deficiency.

products.name: PLK4 Inhibitor Therapeutics (e.g., RP-1664)
products.description: Oral small molecule drugs that selectively inhibit PLK4, designed and manufactured through synthetic processes, for the treatment of solid tumors with TRIM37 amplification or overexpression.

products.name: PKMYT1 Inhibitor Therapeutics (e.g., Lunresertib/RP-6306)
products.description: Oral small molecule inhibitors of PKMYT1, developed and manufactured via synthetic chemistry, for genetically defined solid tumors such as gynecological, colorectal, and upper gastrointestinal cancers.

products.name: ATR Inhibitor Therapeutics (e.g., Camonsertib/RP-3500)
products.description: Oral small molecule inhibitors of ATR kinase, manufactured through synthetic processes, for the treatment of solid tumors with DNA damage repair-related genomic alterations.

products.name: SNIPRx Platform-Based Drug Discovery Partnerships
products.description: Collaborative research services using the proprietary SNIPRx CRISPR-enabled platform to identify and validate novel synthetic lethality targets for external partners, delivered as research collaborations and licensing agreements.

products.name: AD04 (Ondansetron 0.33mg) for Alcohol Use Disorder (AUD)
products.description: An orally administered, low-dose ondansetron tablet developed as a therapeutic agent for the treatment of alcohol use disorder in genetically selected patients. Delivered via prescription, it is designed to reduce heavy drinking without requiring abstinence, and is intended for chronic use. The product is currently in clinical development and not yet approved for sale.

products.name: Companion Diagnostic Genetic Test for AD04
products.description: A genetic test used to identify patients with specific genotypes most likely to benefit from AD04 treatment for alcohol use disorder. The test is intended to be integrated into the treatment protocol and drug label, enabling targeted therapy. It is regulated as a medical device and will require FDA clearance or approval prior to commercialization.

products.name: Thermal Coal
products.description: High-quality thermal coal produced primarily through underground longwall and surface mining at complexes such as the Pennsylvania Mining Complex, Black Thunder, Coal Creek, and West Elk. The coal is processed (where required) and delivered via rail and export terminals to electric power generators and industrial customers domestically and internationally.

products.name: Metallurgical Coal
products.description: Premium metallurgical coal produced from underground longwall and continuous miner operations at mines such as Leer, Leer South, Beckley, Mountain Laurel, and Itmann. The coal is processed and supplied to global and domestic steel producers for use in steelmaking.

products.name: Coal Export Terminal Services
products.description: Coal export terminal services provided through ownership and operation of marine terminals (Core Marine Terminal and Dominion Terminal), including storage, blending, and transloading of coal for international customers. Services are delivered via rail-to-vessel infrastructure with significant throughput capacity.

products.name: Carbon Foam and Advanced Carbon Materials
products.description: Manufacture and sale of high-performance carbon foam products and advanced carbon materials derived from coal, used in aerospace, military, industrial, and commercial applications. Production involves specialized processing of coal feedstocks at dedicated facilities.

products.name: Aerospace Parts Manufacturing
products.description: Production and sale of aerospace parts, including composite tooling and components, utilizing proprietary carbon foam and composite materials. Manufacturing is performed at acquired and expanded facilities, serving aerospace industry customers.

products.name: Battery Anode Materials
products.description: Development and initial sale of battery anode materials produced from coal and coal mining/preparation plant waste streams, targeting battery applications. Activities include research, pilot production, and early-stage commercialization.

products.name: Coal Processing Services for Third Parties
products.description: Processing and blending of third-party coal at company-owned preparation plants, providing additional saleable tons and generating processing revenue. Services are offered at facilities such as the Itmann preparation plant.

products.name: Ultrasonic Nozzles
products.description: Manufactured and assembled at the company's facility, these nozzles are used by customers and integrated into customers’ machines and systems. Production requires specialized materials, equipment, and technical expertise.

products.name: Coating Systems
products.description: These are systems developed and manufactured by the company for applying coatings, likely using ultrasonic technology. Delivery involves physical manufacturing, assembly, and integration into customer operations.

products.name: Life Settlement Origination and Acquisition
products.description: Abacus originates, acquires, and purchases life insurance policies from policyholders, primarily non-variable universal life insurance, through a regulated process involving underwriting, valuation, and closing. The company acts as a third-party intermediary, paying policyholders more than the cash surrender value and then either holding or trading the policies.

products.name: Life Insurance Brokerage and Digital Insurance Marketplace
products.description: Through AccuQuote and its digital platform, Abacus offers consumers the ability to compare and purchase life insurance products from multiple carriers online, providing quotes and facilitating enrollment in insurance plans.

products.name: Life Settlement Portfolio Management and Trading
products.description: Abacus actively manages acquired life insurance policies, deciding whether to hold them for payout or trade them to institutional investors, generating returns through spreads or realized payouts. This involves ongoing risk assessment and capital allocation.

products.name: Third-Party Policy Servicing
products.description: Abacus provides servicing for bundles of life insurance policies owned by third-party institutions, including large asset managers, generating recurring fee-based revenue based on the value of policies serviced.

products.name: Alternative Asset Management (Funds and ETFs)
products.description: Abacus manages alternative investment funds and exchange-traded funds (ETFs) for institutional and select private clients, focusing on longevity-based assets, fixed-income replacement, and free cash flow equity strategies. The division also offers customizable index strategies and separately managed accounts.

products.name: Asset-Based Finance (ABF) Investment Solutions
products.description: Abacus deploys capital into asset-backed investments, including consumer credit, equipment finance, receivables, small business loans, and intellectual property rights, targeting stable, low-volatility returns for institutional investors through its ABF strategy.

products.name: Health and Longevity Data Technology Services
products.description: Abacus Intel develops and licenses technology platforms that provide real-time mortality verification, missing participant location, and other data-driven solutions for pension funds, government agencies, and insurance-related businesses. These services are delivered via proprietary software and fixed annual contracts.

products.name: Wealth Management and Financial Planning Services
products.description: Abacus Wealth Advisors offers personalized wealth management and financial planning services, leveraging proprietary data and algorithms to create customized plans based on clients’ health, longevity, and financial wellbeing, primarily for financial advisors and their clients.

products.name: MSAI Connect Software Platform
products.description: A cloud-based and on-premises software platform that integrates data from multiple sensor types (thermal, visual, acoustic, vibration, etc.) to provide continuous condition monitoring, early threat detection, and predictive maintenance for critical assets in industrial environments. Delivered as a SaaS subscription or licensed software, it processes real-time sensor data and provides dashboards, anomaly alerts, and AI-driven analytics.

products.name: Multi-Sensor Hardware Devices
products.description: A portfolio of sensor hardware devices, including infrared (thermal) imagers, visible-light cameras, acoustic imagers, vibration sensors, ultraviolet imagers, and laser-based sensors, designed for continuous monitoring of industrial assets. These devices are sold standalone or as part of integrated solutions and are manufactured using both in-house and contract manufacturing.

products.name: Installation and Commissioning Services
products.description: Professional services for on-site installation, hardware mounting, sensor commissioning, and integration of sensor devices with the MSAI Connect platform. Includes configuration of camera views, alert thresholds, and regions of interest to enable rapid deployment and realization of monitoring benefits.

products.name: Calibration and Maintenance Services
products.description: Ongoing services to calibrate and maintain sensor hardware, ensuring continued accuracy and reliability of monitoring systems. These services are provided post-installation to support optimal system performance.

products.name: Atmospheric Water Generation Systems
products.description: Systems that harvest pure distilled water from ambient air using proprietary sorption and pressure swing technology, manufactured at scale and delivered as standalone units or integrated into customer operations. These systems utilize advanced metal-organic frameworks and can be powered by low-grade waste heat, enabling distributed water generation for industrial, commercial, and military customers.

products.name: Industrial Dehumidification Systems
products.description: Dehumidification systems based on AirJoule technology that provide highly energy-efficient dehumidified air for industrial applications, replacing conventional desiccant-based systems and reducing operating expenses for customers in sectors such as manufacturing, food processing, pharmaceuticals, and data centers.

products.name: HVAC Integration Components and Solutions
products.description: Sorbent-coated contactors and related components for integration into HVAC and air conditioning systems, enabling more efficient humidity management, reduced energy consumption, and lower use of refrigerants. Delivered through partnerships with OEMs such as Carrier, these components are manufactured at dedicated facilities and supplied for new and retrofit HVAC applications.

products.name: Water Purchase Agreements (WPA)
products.description: A service model where customers purchase water produced by AirJoule systems on a volumetric basis, rather than buying the equipment outright. This recurring revenue model is designed to accelerate adoption by reducing upfront capital requirements for customers in water-scarce regions or industries.

products.name: Homebuilding Services
products.description: Designs, constructs, and sells single-family and multi-family homes through physical development and construction projects, delivered to customers as completed residences.

products.name: Enzyme Replacement Therapies (ERTs) for Rare Diseases
products.description: Proprietary recombinant enzyme replacement therapies produced via plant cell-based expression, delivered as injectable biologics for long-term treatment of rare genetic disorders such as Gaucher disease (Elelyso) and Fabry disease (Elfabrio). Manufacturing is cGMP-compliant and involves industrial-scale plant cell culture and purification.

products.name: Recombinant Therapeutic Proteins for Uncontrolled Gout (PRX-115)
products.description: Development and production of PEGylated recombinant uricase enzyme (PRX-115) for intravenous infusion in patients with uncontrolled gout, using proprietary plant cell-based expression and chemical modification to enhance half-life and reduce immunogenicity. Currently in clinical trials.

products.name: Recombinant DNase I Therapeutics for NETs-related Diseases (PRX-119)
products.description: Preclinical development of plant cell-expressed, PEGylated recombinant human DNase I (PRX-119) with extended half-life, intended for intravenous administration to treat diseases associated with excessive neutrophil extracellular traps (NETs), such as autoimmune, inflammatory, and fibrotic conditions.

products.name: Antisense Oligonucleotide (ASO) Therapies for Rare Renal Indications
products.description: Discovery and development of novel antisense oligonucleotide therapies targeting multiple genes for rare renal diseases, in collaboration with Secarna Pharmaceuticals, leveraging external AI-enabled oligonucleotide design and internal development capabilities. These are in preclinical research stages.

products.name: Financial Brokerage Services
products.description: Brokerage and trade execution services for a broad range of financial products, including fixed income securities (government and corporate bonds), interest rate and credit derivatives, foreign exchange, equities, and futures and options. Delivered via voice, hybrid, and fully electronic platforms, requiring regulated infrastructure, human expertise, and proprietary technology.

products.name: Energy, Commodities, and Shipping (ECS) Brokerage Services
products.description: Brokerage services for energy and commodities products, including crude and refined oil, power, natural gas, LNG, environmental and emissions products, weather derivatives, metals, coal, soft commodities, biofuels, petrochemicals, and shipping/freight. Delivered through a combination of voice, hybrid, and electronic platforms, leveraging specialized brokers and technology.

products.name: Electronic Trading Platforms
products.description: Provision of proprietary electronic trading platforms for execution of financial and commodity products, including U.S. Treasuries, foreign exchange, futures, and other asset classes. Platforms are delivered digitally and require significant technology development and regulated infrastructure.

products.name: Market Data and Analytics Services
products.description: Provision of real-time, tradable, indicative, end-of-day, and historical market data and analytics across asset classes. Data is sourced from brokerage operations and delivered via direct feeds, FTP, and third-party platforms, requiring proprietary technology and data infrastructure.

products.name: Network and Connectivity Solutions
products.description: Provision of customized, high-performance network, infrastructure, and connectivity solutions for financial market participants, including secure, scalable connectivity, co-located compute services, and marketplace development. Delivered via proprietary technology and global data centers.

products.name: Post-Trade Services
products.description: Post-trade risk mitigation, matching, confirmation, and optimization services for derivatives and other financial products, designed to improve capital and operational efficiency and regulatory compliance. Delivered via proprietary and third-party technology platforms.

products.name: Alternative Asset Liquidity and Primary Capital Solutions
products.description: Provides liquidity and primary capital to alternative asset investors and fund sponsors through proprietary trust structures (ExAlt Plan), using a mix of cash, equity, or debt securities as consideration. Delivered via a regulated, technology-enabled platform and requires financial capital, regulatory compliance, and digital infrastructure.

products.name: Trustee, Custody, and Trust Administration Services
products.description: Offers full-service trustee, custody, and trust administration for alternative assets, including safekeeping of physical and digital securities, data management, and regulatory compliance. Services are delivered through regulated trust company subsidiaries and require in-person human labor, regulated infrastructure, and digital systems.

products.name: Broker-Dealer and Transfer Agent Services
products.description: Provides broker-dealer services (through a FINRA and SEC-registered subsidiary) and transfer agent services in connection with liquidity product offerings. These services facilitate securities transactions and require regulatory licensing, financial infrastructure, and digital delivery.

products.name: Digital Platform (AltAccess) and SaaS Solutions
products.description: Delivers all core products and services through AltAccess, a proprietary online digital platform, which is also being developed for SaaS delivery to intermediaries. Requires proprietary software development, digital infrastructure, and regulatory compliance.

products.name: Alternative Asset Digitization and Security Interest Services (Planned)
products.description: Planned online services to digitize alternative assets by creating controllable electronic records (CERs), facilitate attachment of security interests, and electronic UCC filings. Delivered digitally and requires proprietary technology and regulatory compliance.

products.name: Alternative Asset Insurance Products and Services (Planned)
products.description: Planned insurance products to cover risks related to ownership, management, and transfer of alternative assets, including fiduciary, surety, representation and warranty, and credit risk insurance. Requires regulatory approval and insurance infrastructure.

products.name: Alternative Asset Data Management and Analytics Services
products.description: Provides data collection, evaluation, analytics, and reporting services for alternative assets under custody, including near-time valuation quotations and investment reporting. Delivered digitally and requires proprietary and third-party software systems.

products.name: Dressings and Sauces
products.description: Manufactured and packaged salad dressings and sauces, both refrigerated and shelf-stable, for retail and foodservice channels. Products are produced in company-owned food plants and through third-party manufacturers, and delivered via distributors, brokers, and direct sales.

products.name: Frozen Breads and Rolls
products.description: Frozen garlic breads, yeast rolls, Parkerhouse style rolls, and dinner rolls produced in company facilities and sold under various brands to retail and foodservice customers. Distributed through grocery frozen sections and foodservice distributors.

products.name: Croutons and Salad Toppings
products.description: Shelf-stable croutons and salad toppings manufactured and packaged for retail sale, distributed through grocery stores under company brands.

products.name: Dips (Vegetable and Fruit)
products.description: Refrigerated vegetable and fruit dips produced in company facilities and sold primarily in the retail channel, distributed through grocery produce departments.

products.name: Frozen Pasta
products.description: Frozen pasta products manufactured and packaged for foodservice customers, sold under the Marzetti Frozen Pasta® brand and distributed through foodservice channels.

products.name: Licensed and Private Label Food Products
products.description: Manufacture and sale of sauces, dressings, and frozen rolls under exclusive brand license agreements (e.g., Chick-fil-A®, Olive Garden®, Buffalo Wild Wings®, Texas Roadhouse®, Subway®) and private label products for both retail and foodservice customers. Products are produced in company plants and distributed through retail and foodservice channels.

products.name: Construction Equipment
products.description: Heavy and general construction machinery including excavators, loaders, graders, pavers, compactors, and related parts and worktools, manufactured in-house and distributed globally through dealers.

products.name: Mining Equipment
products.description: Surface and underground mining equipment such as electric rope shovels, draglines, mining trucks, loaders, and related parts and technology solutions, manufactured and delivered globally.

products.name: Power Generation Systems
products.description: Reciprocating engine-powered generator sets and integrated power systems for electric power generation, manufactured and supplied globally through dealers and distributors.

products.name: Industrial Engines and Drivetrain Systems
products.description: Reciprocating engines, drivetrain, and integrated systems supplied to industrial, marine, and oil and gas industries, manufactured and distributed globally.

products.name: Gas Turbines and Compressors
products.description: Industrial gas turbines, centrifugal gas compressors, and related turbine services for oil and gas and electric power generation, manufactured and delivered to global customers.

products.name: Diesel-Electric and Hybrid Locomotives
products.description: Diesel-electric and hybrid locomotives, components, and other rail-related products and services, manufactured and sold to rail industry customers worldwide.

products.name: Aftermarket Parts and Product Support
products.description: Replacement parts, maintenance components, worktools, and product support services for Caterpillar equipment, delivered through a global dealer network.

products.name: Equipment Financing Services
products.description: Retail and wholesale financing for customers and dealers to purchase or lease Caterpillar and other equipment, provided through Cat Financial and its subsidiaries.

products.name: Insurance Services
products.description: Property, casualty, life, health, and equipment insurance and reinsurance products, including contractual liability and cargo insurance, provided through Caterpillar Insurance subsidiaries.

products.name: Technology Solutions for Equipment Management
products.description: Digital technology products and services for fleet management, equipment analytics, autonomous machine capabilities, safety services, and mining performance solutions, delivered to equipment customers.

products.name: Remanufacturing Services
products.description: Remanufacturing of Caterpillar engines and components, as well as remanufacturing services for other companies, involving the rebuilding and restoration of used products to like-new condition.

products.name: Laser Cleaning and Surface Preparation Systems
products.description: Industrial-grade laser systems for cleaning, rust removal, de-coating, pre-welding and post-welding, and surface conditioning, replacing traditional sandblasting and chemical cleaning. Delivered as handheld, cabinet, automated, and robotic solutions, manufactured in-house and compliant with safety regulations.

products.name: Laser Material Processing Systems (Cutting, Marking, Engraving, Drilling, Welding, Brazing, Ablation)
products.description: Turnkey laser systems for industrial material processing applications including cutting, marking, engraving, drilling, welding, brazing, and ablation, used in manufacturing and fabrication. These systems are based on proprietary and licensed technologies and are delivered as integrated equipment for various industries.

products.name: Laser Systems for Pharmaceutical Manufacturing
products.description: Precision laser systems for pharmaceutical manufacturing, specifically for creating micro-drilled apertures in controlled-release tablets to ensure accurate and consistent drug release. These systems are delivered as turnkey solutions to pharmaceutical companies and require high-precision engineering and compliance with industry standards.

products.name: Laser-Based Anti-Drone Defense Systems
products.description: Laser defense systems designed to neutralize small-scale unmanned aerial systems (UAS), such as the Laser Shield Anti-Drone System (LSAD), developed for government and defense applications. These systems are developed in partnership with affiliates and delivered as specialized solutions for security and defense sectors.

products.name: Medical Professional Liability Insurance
products.description: Insurance coverage for healthcare providers and institutions against claims of medical malpractice or professional negligence. Delivered through underwriting, claims management, and risk management services, primarily via independent agencies and brokers.

products.name: Medical Technology and Life Sciences Liability Insurance
products.description: Liability insurance for medical technology and life sciences companies, covering products-completed operations and errors and omissions for regulated medical devices, pharmaceuticals, and biologics, including coverage for clinical trials. Delivered through underwriting and claims management, primarily via independent brokers.

products.name: Workers' Compensation Insurance
products.description: Insurance products for employers covering workplace injuries and illnesses, including traditional guaranteed cost, dividend, retrospectively-rated, and deductible policies, as well as alternative market solutions. Delivered through underwriting, claims management, and risk management services, distributed via independent agents.

products.name: Alternative Risk and Captive Insurance Solutions
products.description: Custom insurance and reinsurance solutions, including assumed reinsurance and turnkey captive programs, for healthcare entities and employers seeking tailored risk transfer options. Delivered through segregated portfolio cells (SPCs) in the Cayman Islands and other captive arrangements.

products.name: Segregated Portfolio Cell Reinsurance
products.description: Reinsurance services provided through segregated portfolio cells (SPCs) in the Cayman Islands, assuming medical professional liability and workers' compensation risks from clients and allocating results to cell participants. Delivered via licensed SPC entities, with investment and underwriting managed for the benefit of cell owners.

products.name: Over-the-Counter (OTC) Analgesic Products
products.description: Manufactured and marketed pain relief powders and related OTC analgesic products, primarily under the BC and Goody's brands, distributed through mass merchandisers, drug, food, dollar, convenience, club stores, and e-commerce channels. Production is primarily outsourced to third-party manufacturers.

products.name: Dermatological Products
products.description: OTC dermatological treatments including diaper rash ointments, wart removal, and lice/parasite treatments, sold under brands such as Boudreaux's Butt Paste, Compound W, and Nix. Products are manufactured by third parties and distributed through retail and e-commerce channels.

products.name: Cough, Cold, and Allergy Relief Products
products.description: OTC products for sore throat, cough, and nasal/sinus congestion, including medicated and non-medicated sprays, lozenges, and nasal saline washes, marketed under brands such as Chloraseptic, Luden's, and Fess. Products are manufactured by third parties and distributed through multiple retail channels.

products.name: Eye and Ear Care Products
products.description: OTC eye drops for redness, dryness, and itchiness, ear wax removal solutions, and dry eye relief products, sold under brands such as Clear Eyes, Debrox, and TheraTears. Products are manufactured by third parties and distributed through retail and e-commerce channels.

products.name: Oral Care Products
products.description: OTC oral care products including dental guards, floss picks, interdental brushes, dental repair kits, and tongue cleaners, primarily under the DenTek brand. Products are manufactured by third parties and distributed through retail and e-commerce channels.

products.name: Gastrointestinal Health Products
products.description: OTC gastrointestinal products including motion sickness relief, enemas, laxatives, upset stomach remedies, and oral rehydration solutions, marketed under brands such as Dramamine, Fleet, Gaviscon, and Hydralyte. Products are manufactured by third parties and distributed through retail and e-commerce channels in North America and internationally.

products.name: Women's Health Products
products.description: OTC women's health products including vaginal anti-fungal treatments and feminine hygiene products, sold under brands such as Monistat and Summer's Eve. Products are manufactured by third parties and distributed through retail and e-commerce channels.

products.name: Mortgage Brokerage Services
products.description: Origination and brokering of residential and commercial mortgages for consumers and businesses in Canada, delivered through licensed agents and brokers using proprietary technology platforms. Services include mortgage consultation, access to multiple lenders, rate negotiation, and assistance throughout the mortgage process.

products.name: Mortgage Technology Platform (MyPineapple / Pineapple+)
products.description: Cloud-based, proprietary software platform providing mortgage lifecycle management, CRM, document collection, compliance workflows, analytics, and integrations for mortgage agents, brokers, and brokerages. Delivered as a subscription service and integrated with brokerage operations.

products.name: Pre-Underwriting and Back-Office Support Services
products.description: Technology-enabled pre-underwriting, documentation preparation, credit review, data validation, fraud analysis, appraisal ordering, and administrative support for mortgage agents and brokerages. Delivered digitally via the MyPineapple platform and charged per deal or as part of brokerage services.

products.name: Insurance Products and Services (via Pineapple Insurance)
products.description: Distribution and management of life, critical illness, credit, and permanent insurance products, as well as investment options (segregated funds, mutual funds) for mortgage clients. Delivered as a managing general agent (MGA) in partnership with Industrial Alliance, integrated with mortgage origination and approval processes.

products.name: Agency Residential Mortgage-Backed Securities (Agency RMBS)
products.description: Investments in pass-through certificates and collateralized mortgage obligations backed by pools of residential mortgage loans, with principal and interest payments guaranteed by U.S. Government-sponsored enterprises or agencies. These are acquired and managed using financial capital and sophisticated modeling, and delivered as investment products to external investors.

products.name: To-Be-Announced Forward Contracts (TBAs)
products.description: Forward contracts to purchase or sell Agency RMBS in the TBA market, specifying coupon rate, issuer, term, and face value, with actual bonds identified shortly before settlement. These are financial instruments used for investment and off-balance sheet financing, delivered digitally to institutional investors.

products.name: Agency Multifamily Mortgage-Backed Securities (Agency multifamily MBS)
products.description: Securities backed by mortgage loans secured by multifamily properties, primarily issued under Fannie Mae's DUS program, with GSE guarantees. These are structured investment products delivered to institutional investors.

products.name: Credit Risk Transfer (CRT) Securities
products.description: Risk-sharing instruments that transfer a portion of the credit risk from pools of conventional residential mortgage loans from GSEs or third parties to private investors. These are structured financial products delivered to institutional investors.

products.name: Non-Agency Residential Mortgage-Backed Securities (Non-Agency RMBS)
products.description: Structured securities backed by pools of residential mortgages issued by private institutions, which may include various credit enhancements. These are investment products focused on U.S. residential properties, delivered to institutional investors.

products.name: Commercial Mortgage-Backed Securities (CMBS)
products.description: Securities backed by pools of loans secured by commercial properties, structured into multiple classes with varying risk and return profiles. These are investment products delivered to institutional investors, focusing on U.S. commercial real estate.

products.name: Industrial Net Lease Real Estate
products.description: Ownership and leasing of single-tenant industrial properties, including manufacturing, warehouse and distribution, food processing, cold storage, flex-space, and research and development facilities. Properties are physically acquired, managed, and leased on a long-term net lease basis to external tenants.

products.name: Retail Net Lease Real Estate
products.description: Ownership and leasing of single-tenant retail properties, including general merchandise, quick service restaurants, casual dining, automotive, animal services, home furnishings, and healthcare services. Properties are physically acquired, managed, and leased on a long-term net lease basis to external tenants.

products.name: Transitional Capital Investments
products.description: Provision of preferred equity and real estate lending to external parties for transitional capital needs, including financing for retail and industrial development projects. These are financial products rather than physical real estate assets, typically shorter in duration and structured as preferred equity or loans.

products.name: Modular Construction Services
products.description: Design, manufacture, and delivery of pre-fabricated modular structures using steel or wood, for permanent or temporary use in residential, commercial, healthcare, military, education, and other sectors. Modules are produced in company-owned factories and delivered to customer sites for installation and finish-out.

products.name: Turnkey Modular Healthcare Facilities and Medical Testing Services
products.description: Provision of turnkey modular solutions for medical testing and treatment, including the design, manufacture, and delivery of modular clinics and labs, as well as revenue-generating medical testing services. These are delivered using the company's modular technology and may include on-site installation and setup.

products.name: Real Estate Development Using Modular Construction
products.description: Development, co-development, and financing of single and multi-family housing projects in underserved regions, utilizing company-manufactured modular units. Projects are built using modules produced in vertically integrated factories and may involve direct property acquisition or joint ventures.

products.name: Biomedical Waste Removal and Treatment Services
products.description: Sustainable biomedical waste removal and treatment services utilizing licensed patented technology to shred and disinfect biomedical waste for safe disposal. Services are targeted at healthcare facilities and use specialized equipment to render waste safe and unrecognizable.

products.name: Investment Management Services
products.description: Comprehensive investment management solutions across public fixed income, private credit, public equity, real estate, and multi-asset strategies, delivered to institutional and retail clients globally through proprietary and third-party channels. Services are provided via actively managed funds, ETFs, separately managed accounts, and custom solutions, with revenues primarily from asset management fees.

products.name: Institutional Retirement Solutions
products.description: Retirement investment and income products for institutional clients, including pension risk transfer group annuities, longevity reinsurance, guaranteed investment contracts, funding agreements, structured settlements, and stable value wraps. Products are distributed to plan sponsors and intermediaries, with revenues from premiums, policy charges, and investment income.

products.name: Individual Annuities
products.description: Variable and fixed annuity products for individuals, including indexed-variable annuities (FlexGuard suite), single premium annuities, and variable annuities, offering features such as index-linked returns, principal protection, guaranteed withdrawal payments, and tax-deferred growth. Delivered through financial professionals and third-party distributors.

products.name: Group Insurance
products.description: Group life, group disability (short-term and long-term), and supplemental health insurance (accident, critical illness, hospital indemnity) products for institutional employers, associations, and affinity groups. Products are distributed via proprietary sales force and brokers, with revenues from premiums and policy charges.

products.name: Individual Life Insurance
products.description: Variable life, universal life, and term life insurance products for individuals, offering permanent or term coverage, cash value accumulation, and options for estate and wealth transfer planning. Products are distributed through independent brokers, banks, and proprietary channels.

products.name: International Insurance and Retirement Products
products.description: Life insurance, retirement income, investment contracts, and accident & health products for individuals in Japan, Brazil, Mexico, and other international markets. Includes traditional whole life, term, variable life, endowments, investment contracts, and supplemental health benefits, distributed via proprietary agents and third-party channels.
